context.body: The builder’s achievement is placed inside a longer story of mobile presence and prophetic correction.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Stephen recalls the wilderness tent, David’s desire, Solomon’s building, and Isaiah’s claim that the Most High does not dwell in handmade houses.
observations.label: Stephen places Solomon’s house under prophetic critique: action

observations.body: Temple history is honored and relativized within a speech accusing resistant hearers.
observations.label: Stephen places Solomon’s house under prophetic critique: response

observations.body: David · Solomon built · Most High does not dwell · heaven is my throne
observations.label: Words in Acts 7:44–50

payload.posture: Read Acts 7:44–50 as later memory and aftermath evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The critique targets containment, not the claim that the Temple had no place in Israel’s story.
payload.title: Stephen places Solomon’s house under prophetic critique
